title: Pocketwire Rewards Tier Qualification Ladder
content:
Pocketwire Rewards tiers are ranked from Member to Obsidian by quarterly qualifying spend. Each tier has an entry threshold, a retention spend, a number of tolerated quarters below retention and a limit on the tiers dropped at one review.

| Rank | Tier | Entry threshold (quarterly qualifying spend, USD) | Retention spend for the previous calendar quarter (USD) | Consecutive reviews below retention tolerated before a downgrade | Most tiers dropped at one quarterly review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pocketwire Rewards Member | 0.00, with the linked personal account active | 0.00 | 0 | 1 |
| 2 | Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 500.00 | 400.00 | 1 | 1 |
| 3 | Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 1500.00 | 1200.00 | 1 | 1 |
| 4 | Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 3000.00 | 2500.00 | 1 | 1 |
| 5 | Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 6000.00 | 5000.00 | 2 | 1 |
| 6 | Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 12000.00 | 10000.00 | 2 | 1 |

## Terms used in the ladder

- Entry threshold: the minimum quarterly qualifying spend of the tier.
- Retention spend: the qualifying spend in the previous calendar quarter needed to keep the tier at a quarterly review.
- Tolerated reviews below retention: the consecutive quarterly reviews below retention spend that are tolerated before a downgrade.
- Most tiers dropped at one review: the most tiers a membership can drop at one quarterly review, 1 on every tier.

## Reading the ladder

- A quarterly qualifying spend of 3000.00 USD meets the Platinum entry threshold; 2999.99 USD meets Gold's 1500.00 USD but not Platinum's.
- Diamond and Obsidian tolerate 2 consecutive reviews below retention; Silver, Gold and Platinum tolerate 1; Member tolerates 0.
